| description = 
Three of these guys spawn in EW at location #2 on the map. They are a reasonable camp for a quad kiter looking to grind Claws of Veeshan rep in the mid-late 40s and early 50s. Just grab one of the ulthorks nearby for your fourth mob, or the solitary frost giant on the southwest side of the prison area. Avoid kiting mercenaries too close to the buildings or other giants may social through the walls.

Any items given to them will disappear upon death.

6 minute 40 second respawn timer.
